Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog: Fix Rescan leaving old temporary Penumbra changes active — it now removes every temporary mod setting PoseKit applied this session, restoring Penumbra's own default state, before re-scanning. Fix saving an anchored preset with an all-zero offset (e.g. right after clicking Reset) being blocked — the Save button no longer requires a non-zero offset to have been applied, since being in a pose is already the real precondition.
